NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Expense Reimbursement Policy
 Document ID
NT-FIN-004
Department
Finance
Version
2.4
Effective Date
01 April 2025
1. General Rules
Employees can claim reimbursement for business expenses that are reasonable, necessary and
supported by original bills or receipts. Personal expenses are never reimbursable. Claims must be
submitted through the Expense Portal within 30 days of the expense date; claims submitted later
are rejected.
2. Approval Limits
Claims up to Rs. 5,000 are approved by the reporting manager. Claims between Rs. 5,001 and Rs.
25,000 need approval from the department head. Claims above Rs. 25,000 need approval from the
Finance Controller. Receipts are mandatory for any single expense above Rs. 500.
3. Meals and Client Entertainment
Employees on business duty may claim meals up to Rs. 800 per day. Client entertainment
expenses are capped at Rs. 2,500 per person per event and must have prior approval from the
department head. Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances.
4. Mobile and Internet
Employees in client-facing roles may claim up to Rs. 600 per month for mobile phone bills. Internet
reimbursement for remote work is covered in the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy.
5. Professional Development
Each employee has an annual learning budget of Rs. 30,000 for courses, certifications and books.
Courses costing more than Rs. 30,000 need written approval from the department head. If an
employee leaves within 12 months of completing a company-paid certification, the cost must be
repaid.
6. Payment Timeline
Approved claims are paid with the next salary cycle if approved before the 20th of the month.
Claims approved after the 20th are paid in the following month. Payments are made to the
employee's registered salary bank account.
Document Notice
Confidentiality Notice: This document is the property of NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and is
intended for internal use by employees only. Unauthorised copying, sharing or distribution outside
